confidenceQualification.state: selection control for the October 28 follow-up
confidenceQualification.scope: Every DPS race/build (32 builds, 209 profiles) on the October 28 engine, with each build's published talents, rotation, consumables, race and enchants fixed. Tanks keep their separately selected equipment.
confidenceQualification.rule: A searched loadout is kept only if, averaged over the search seed (20261028) and an independent confirmation seed (30296071) at 5,000 fights each, its gain exceeds 1.96 times the sum of the two arms' standard errors (validate_gear.py's rule).
confidenceQualification.limits: Coordinate search with coupled weapon layouts, not an exhaustive combination search; the modeled level-65 pool is hypothetical, not obtainable loot.

postSearchCorrections.description: The search changed weapons without changing their stones. Nine selected loadouts carried a Dense Weightstone on an edged weapon; it was replaced by a Dense Sharpening Stone, which the engine models identically (+8 weapon damage). DPS is unchanged. The search now swaps the stone with the weapon.
